[SWS_DM_01569] Configurable reset of the pendingDTC bit in case of displace-
ment
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04067, RS_Diag_04118
⌈
If an event memory entry was removed during displacement and the configura-
tion parameter
DiagnosticCommonProps.resetPendingBitOnOverflow
is set
to "
true
", the DM module shall reset the
UDS DTC status bit
2 / ’pendingDTC’ to
0.
⌋
